values.value: Reads your acknowledgment rules when a gift is saved and marks a gift Not required when a rule says no thank you is needed, so the list of gifts waiting to be thanked is only the gifts you mean to thank. It never overwrites a decision somebody made by hand. It also writes the acknowledgment record when a gift is marked Acknowledged, whether that happens on the record, in a list view, through an import or through the API. Switching it off leaves every gift at To acknowledge and stops the acknowledgment records being written; nothing already recorded changes.
